Tenant log queries dashboard
- variable tenant id
- usage breakdown by app
- top10 expensive queries single
- top10 expensive queries aggregated
- *scanned buckets 
- *timeframes distribution
- reaching scanLimit

Playground notebook: https://ntd44713.apps.dynatrace.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.notebooks/notebook/f4a0d344-c4ec-4e20-a11d-fbc250939321

1.title: Base query

2.title: Usage breakdown by app

3.title: Top10 most expensive queries (single run)

4.title: Top10 most expensive queries (multiple runs)

5.title: Overview

6.title: Number of queries by number of queried buckets in a single query

8.title: Query costs over time (weekly bins)
8.query:
fetch logs, scanLimitGBytes:-1
| filter dt.system.bucket=="custom_sen_low_query_frontend_dql_logs"
| filterOut matchesPhrase(content, "fetch dt.system.events") or matchesPhrase(content, "dt.system.query_executions")
// show only log queries
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "fetch logs")
| filter contains(content, "DqlQueryLog") and contains(content, "JSON:{")
| parse content, "LD ' JSON:' JSON:query"
| fields timestamp, query
| fieldsFlatten query
| fieldsRemove query
// ---
| filter isNotNull(query.client.application_context)
| filter isNull(query.client.function_context)
| filter query.billable_bytes > 0
| filter query.tenant == $tenant
| fields timestamp, query.id, query.dql, query.tenant, query.start_time, query.duration_ms, query.success, query.observations, query.billable_bytes, query.scanned_bytes, query.analysis_timeframe_start, query.analysis_timeframe_end, query.dql_commands, query.client.application_context, query.user, query.buckets
| fieldsAdd week = getWeekOfYear(timestamp)
| summarize timestamp = min(timestamp), queries_executions=count(), billable_bytes_p80 = percentile(query.billable_bytes, 80), queries_distinct = countDistinct(query.dql), unique_users=countDistinct(query.user), tenants=countDistinct(query.tenant), billable_bytes = sum(query.billable_bytes), billable_bytes_med = median(query.billable_bytes), by:{week}
| fieldsAdd usd = billable_bytes / (1024*1024*1024) * 0.0035
| fieldsAdd avg_cost = usd / queries_executions
| fieldsAdd med_cost = billable_bytes_med / (1024*1024*1024) * 0.0035
| fieldsAdd p80_cost = billable_bytes_p80 / (1024*1024*1024) * 0.0035

dt.statistics.ui.ForecastAnalyzer.query:
fetch dt.system.events, from:now()-7d, to:now()
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter event.type == "Log Management & Analytics - Query"
| filter event.version == "1.0"
//| makeTimeseries query_count=count(), query_volume=sum(billed_bytes / 1024 / 1024 / 1024.0), interval:1h
| makeTimeseries query_count=count(), interval:1h
| fieldsAdd query_count=arrayMovingAvg(query_count, 5)
